# image_optim_pack

**Tag**: library

## 简介

Precompiled binaries for image_optim: advpng, gifsicle, jhead, jpeg-recompress, jpegoptim, jpegtran, optipng, oxipng, pngcrush, pngout, pngquant

## 官网

- 主页: https://github.com/toy/image_optim_pack
- 文档: https://www.rubydoc.info/gems/image_optim_pack/0.13.1.20260816
- 更新日志: https://github.com/toy/image_optim_pack/blob/master/CHANGELOG.markdown
- 问题追踪: https://github.com/toy/image_optim_pack/issues
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/image_optim_pack
